caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with an ornate design. The chair features a tall, curved back support with a central splat that is elegantly shaped and topped with a carved shell motif. The legs of the chair are cabriole-shaped and end in claw-and-ball feet. Each knee of the chair’s front legs is adorned with a carved shell decoration similar to that on the crest rail. The seat is upholstered in a rich, deep pink or burgundy fabric with a smooth texture. The wood of the chair is rendered in warm brown tones, showing visible grain and highlighting the carved details. Supporting stretchers connect the legs for additional stability. The chair is centered against a plain, off-white or light beige background, set within a thin, rectangular border.
title: Side Chair
